assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent car selection portrait for VELOCITY GP racing game. A single modern original open-wheel formula racing car, photorealistic professional automotive studio photograph. Exactly four exposed black slick tires, narrow long sculpted nose, low multi-element front wing, compact tapered sidepods, sculpted engine cover, black carbon floor and rear diffuser, rear wing, black protective halo and small driver helmet. Three-quarter front-right view, nose pointing to lower right, entire car visible with generous margins. Camera at low body height, long focal length, no wide-angle distortion. Faithful contemporary motorsport proportions, intricate fine carbon weave. Transparent background, no floor, no pedestal, no room, no shadow outside vehicle, no words, no logos, no watermark. Team livery: deep racing red lacquer with broad pearl white tapered stripes and restrained black carbon accents; red rear wing endplates, white wing planes.
